project_type: Flutter/Dart mobile app 'plantsense_ai' — an AI plant & soil assistant (chat, image diagnosis, weather-aware care). Firebase (auth/firestore/storage), Riverpod state, TypeScript Cloud Functions AI proxy.
build_system: Flutter pub. No android/ios committed (run tool/setup_platforms.sh for device builds). Host validation uses flutter analyze + flutter test only.
test_framework: flutter_test + mocktail. Tests under test/ (unit/, providers/, widgets/) and integration_test/. Fakes/mocks in test/mocks/mocks.dart and test/widgets/test_app.dart. No network in tests.
build_command: flutter pub get (also runs gen-l10n because pubspec has generate: true)
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH=/opt/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH  2) cd APP-TEST  3) flutter pub get  4) flutter analyze (must report 'No issues found!')  5) flutter test (all tests must pass). Flutter must be run as root here; ignore the 'trying to run flutter as root' warning (harmless).
snapshot_or_generated_files: lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart are generated from lib/l10n/app_*.arb by `flutter gen-l10n` (auto-run during `flutter pub get`). NEVER hand-edit the generated Dart; edit the .arb files (app_en.arb is the template; app_ar.arb, app_fr.arb, app_es.arb are translations, fr/es fall back to English). After editing .arb run `flutter pub get` or `flutter gen-l10n`.
setup_instructions: Flutter is NOT preinstalled in the sandbox. It has been installed at /opt/flutter-sdk (Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2, stable). Use it via: export PATH="/opt/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH". `flutter pub get` already run once and resolved 174 deps successfully. git safe.directory is set to '*'.
environment_constraints: Network is OPEN (public registries reachable; Flutter SDK + pub packages downloaded successfully). Flutter 3.47.2 is NEWER than the project's documented 3.35.1 baseline but satisfies pubspec `flutter: >=3.35.0` and analyze+test are green on it. No Android SDK / Xcode / device — cannot run `flutter build apk/ios` or integration_test (needs a device). Do NOT create android/ or ios/ dirs. /tmp is volatile across shells; /opt and /projects persist.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. README is authoritative: feature-first architecture (each feature = application/ data/ domain/ presentation/). No secrets in client. AI results must carry a disclaimer (not a substitute for professionals). Localize all user-facing strings via .arb + AppLocalizations. Analyze must stay clean; tests must stay green. flutter_lints ^4.0.0 rules apply.
key_patterns: AI flow: a feature 'data' service builds an AiRequest (systemPrompt from AiPrompts, userText, context map, optional AiImage, jsonMode:true for structured JSON) and calls ref.watch(aiGatewayProvider).generate(); the transport is swappable (BackendAiGateway proxy / OpenAiCompatibleGateway direct / DemoAiGateway canned). Structured results are parsed by a domain model's static `parse(raw)` that tolerates ```json fences + surrounding prose and extracts the first balanced {...} (see Diagnosis.parse/_extractJson). Models expose fromJson/toMap/fromStored/withMeta and degrade gracefully on malformed data. State via StateNotifier + a *State copyWith class and a *ControllerProvider; a stage enum drives multi-step UI. Persistence via an abstract Repository with a Local(SharedPreferences via LocalCacheService) impl and a Firestore(+Storage) impl selected by Environment.isDemo/currentUser (see diagnosis_repository.dart). Location/weather context comes from aiContextProvider (values map + displayStrip). Home is a 4-tab IndexedStack in home_screen.dart with a NavigationBar; titles from _titleFor + l10n. DemoAiGateway must return sensible canned output for any new jsonMode request so demo mode stays fully usable.
relevant_files: lib/features/diagnosis/application/diagnosis_provider.dart (PATTERN: StateNotifier controller, stage enum, aiContext usage)
lib/features/diagnosis/presentation/diagnosis_screen.dart + widgets/diagnosis_result_card.dart (PATTERN: multi-stage screen + result card UI)
lib/core/services/ai_gateway.dart (AiGateway/AiRequest/AiImage — do not need to change)
lib/core/services/demo_ai_gateway.dart (add canned soil-report JSON for the new jsonMode request)

test/unit/diagnosis_parse_test.dart + test/mocks/mocks.dart + test/widgets/test_app.dart (PATTERN for new tests)
